sourceSentences: [0] Plays the same as Velkoz with little bit less hard engage through his stun being blockable by minions.
[0] Skill Matchup and Adc dependent, boxblock his stun, pray that your adc can dodge skillshots. outscale.
[0] Hug side brushes, throw Qs from fog, and fish for E+Flash when they waste stun/knockup on minions.
[0] Strong poke and range, but vulnerable when his E is down
[0] Mage matchups like Xearth needs very patient play. Buy boots early to help dodging. Only go all-in when the stun is on cooldown.
[0] His stun [[Shocking Orb]] (E) and burst damage make trading risky if you get caught out. Focus on dodging his skillshots and wait for cooldowns before engaging.
[0] Annoying mage champion, but if you are able to get on top of him, is very punishable and will nearly always result in a kill or burned summs.
[0] Out ranges you. Out damages you. However he's an immobile champion and easy to kill with jungle assistance. Painful to lane against.
[0] Since he must stand perfectly still to cast his long-range artillery (namely his R), he becomes an incredibly easy target for you to hit with maximum-range bubbles or tidal wave.
[0] Stupidly long range, stupidly high damage, can delete you. But also. Squishy and easy to hit while he channels.
[0] his ult reveals his position, so just jump onto him and beat the living shit out of him when he uses it.
[1] very fun matchup because damage is quite even, try fight inside your minions so she doesnt get single target q and w on you, way less damage
[1] Most importantly fight her in your minions so she can't fully Q you, and try to dodge her W during fights, which might be difficult.
[1] long range W into Ultimate and Q burst is super dangerous. Natural counter pick vs Ezreal.
[1] Do not let Kai'sa get her stacks. Wait for them to wear off before engaging. Stay behind minions in order to dodge her W.
[1] Ideal trades are ones where Kai'Sa can't hit proc her passive.
[1] Need to play around cooldowns and take shorts trades so she doesnt get passive off. If the fights is going long enough to proc her passive your probably losing.
[1] Kai'Sa is very vulnerable to getting outranged by mages and long range carries.
